set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F06
Accountable role (person not assigned): Integration engineer with curator

Outcome: A retained end-to-end demonstration of sign-in, organization, sharing and offboarding across two labs.

Acceptance:
- Exercise real browser/HTTP/PostgreSQL with two labs, reader/contributor/steward roles, one external collaborator and a migrated preexisting dataset.
- Demonstrate denied discovery, sharing/revocation, membership removal, principal disablement, concurrent role changes and stewardship handover while preserving historical releases and attribution.
- Retain source-bound automated and human workflow/accessibility evidence with explicit not-run provider or screen-reader gates; completion of this tranche does not assert institutional readiness.

Evidence anchors:
- scripts/check-console-backend.sh
- docs/evidence/console/adoption.json
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#immediate-six-mote-foundation-tranche

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: F06: Qualify the two-lab institutional foundation journey
